decision.owner: Repository owner Yes on the narrow contract-evolution policy amendment, 2026-10-15; applied here by the coordinator after independent review
decision.reference: Authorization bead bu-ybgja6 for implementation bead bu-3rd8wy (PR #4730, verify-all sweeps hold a cross-sweep lock so a second concurrent sweep is refused instead of overlapping, and the frontend verify-all timeout covers the seeded catalog serial probes: 8 x 50s = 400s). Reviewed before: main 0a4f5f29b6d590952c5a79d00df0f71829ced647; approved subject: PR #4730 head 3ea90e69d38ff186b2f0ea3b5288ace0c549af8f (review bu-tkhu13). Governing requirement REQ-dashboard-model-settings-003 (Catalog Verify-All API) of openspec/specs/dashboard-model-settings/spec.md, which gains its ID in this change because the pre-change block carries none. This exact manifest requires its own independent review and protected-main publication before consumption; provenance text grants no runtime admission.

owners.reason: REQ-dashboard-model-settings-003 now requires run_verify_all_models to hold a non-blocking Postgres advisory lock on one acquired connection for the whole sweep (Cross-sweep exclusion). The module's shared _pool helper therefore gains pool.acquire(), an async context manager whose connection answers the lock and unlock fetchval with True, so a verify-all sweep proceeds exactly as before; tests that never run a sweep never call acquire(). The ledger attributes every test in this module to the changed helper. Fixture-only: no assertion, case, parametrization or expected value changes in any test here.
